messages:
incident_bot: [P1] GeoDNS anomaly: increased DNS resolution latency and intermittent NXDOMAINs seen from EU resolvers; Route53 health checks flapping for geo-weighted records (us-east/us-west/eu). Auto-page to oncall.

pager_sre_alex: oncall responding, acknowledging. I'm picking this up — tagging netops for DNS-level triage. severity P1 if customer-facing routing broken. @netops_jane can you confirm? :rotating_light:

netops_jane: seeing elevated latency from multiple EU resolver vantage points (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 and ISP resolvers). Dig from eu-west shows TTLs honored but some queries returning SERVFAIL and others normal. Route53 health checks show elevated failures to eu origin pool.

infra_bob: adding what I see from infra: our GeoDNS controller is receiving health check failures from Route53 for the eu pool around 02:10 UTC. No recent deploys. Metrics: origin connection errors spike ~02:08-02:14, then partial recoveries. Could be an external resolver/resolution issue.

netops_jane: opened Cloudflare ticket (CASE-82712). Also opened AWS support SR for Route53 health-check flapping (SR-45233). Pastie of a dig run:
```
; dig +short @1.1.1.1 api.redwood.example.com A
;; -> 93.184.216.34
; dig +time=3 +tries=1 @1.0.0.1 api.redwood.example.com A
;; connection timed out; no servers could be reached
```

support_elise: we have 7 customers reporting elevated request latencies and some 502s starting 02:12 UTC. CS triage attached customer list: cust-orpheus, cust-lumen, cust-scribe (all EU-heavy). Alerted account owners.

prod_ops_amy: quick impact check — internal synthetic canaries in eu showed DNS resolution failures causing fallback route to global pool. Some traffic got routed to us-west causing latency spikes. No data exfil. Marking as customer-impacting.

pager_sre_alex: short mitigation plan options:
- Option A: Force GeoDNS to prefer us-west temporarily by adjusting weights (fast changes) and lower TTL to 20s to accelerate migration.
- Option B: Temporarily set Route53 failover to secondary origin (if health checks unreliable) and raise health-check tolerance.
- Option C: Add static A records for critical endpoints to bypass external resolver if Cloudflare resolver is failing at regional level.

eng_region_ops: I'd prefer A + TTL drop first to steer traffic off the flapping eu pool while we investigate resolver issues. B is more invasive but available.

netops_jane: agree. I'll lower TTL for geo records to 20s and change weight to favor us-west by 70/30 within the next 3 minutes. Will monitor propagation with `dig` from eu and us.

infra_bob: prepping runbook commands.

infra_bob: executing:
```
# update Route53 weights
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch file://weight-change.json
# set TTL
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch file://ttl-20.json
```

netops_jane: changes submitted at 02:20 UTC. Monitoring.

incident_bot: Action recorded: Route53 weight update and TTL change applied by infra_bob at 02:20:37 UTC.

support_elise: customer updates drafted for impacted accounts. Short note: "We're seeing DNS resolution issues in EU that may route traffic to alternate region; we're mitigating and will provide updates." Ready to send once we have stability.

eng_region_ops: telemetry looks better after 02:25 — EU resolvers show consistent responses to prefered us-west IPs. Error rates for cust-orpheus down 80%. Still seeing occasional SERVFAIL from a subset of EU ISP resolvers.

pager_sre_alex: next steps: keep TTL low for 30m, maintain new weights for 60m, follow up with Cloudflare/AWS tickets for root cause. Postmortem owner: netops_jane. Timeline: 3:00 PM UTC postmortem meeting invite. Severity confirmed P1 -> impact: partial regional DNS failures affecting EU customers.

customer_success_maria: looped in impacted customer success reps and scheduled outreach. Will wait for final summary before sending formal notice.

netops_jane: Cloudflare responded: their EU resolver edge had a config push that caused transient resolution saturation for some tenant zones; they are rolling a rollback and will share RCA. AWS looking into health-check sensitivity.

pager_sre_alex: handoff to follow-up oncall (infra_bob) at 02:40 UTC. I'll jump to postmortem once immediate alerts quiet. Good job team, keep me posted if errors creep back. :thumbsup:

infra_bob: taking over monitoring. Leaving the routing changes in place until Cloudflare confirms full roll-back and we see stable resolver responses for 30m.

incident_bot: incident transitioned to watch mode by infra_bob at 02:41:10 UTC. Ticket links: CASE-82712 (Cloudflare), SR-45233 (AWS).
